newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds buoyed with peripherals.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds buoyed with peripherals.

text.p: Portuguese bonds were well-supported in line with peripheral markets after the Italian lira re-joined the European exchange rate mechanism (ERM), dealers said.
They said they expected yield spreads to consolidate at current levels between five and 10 basis points below 10-year Bonos.
"Futures and cash are well-supported and consolidating at current levels," one operator said. "After the re-entry of the lira to the ERM, sentiment is more optimistic."
Money rates were calm. Overnight and tomorrow/next stood at 6.55/6.75 percent, compared with 6.75/6.80 percent on Friday.
